title: Parker-Hannifin Strikes Deal to Buy Unit of KKR-Owned Circor for $2.55 Billion
title_zh: Parker-Hannifin 达成协议以 25.5 亿美元收购 KKR 旗下 Circor 部门
summary: Parker-Hannifin  struck a deal to acquire the commercial and defense aerospace unit of Circor from  KKR  for $2.55 billion in cash. The sale would mark a huge return on KKR’s initial investment into Circor.
summary_zh: 派克汉尼汾公司达成协议，以 25.5 亿美元现金从 KKR 手中收购 Circor 的商业和国防航空航天部门。此次出售将标志着 KKR 对 Circor 的初始投资获得巨额回报。

title: Anthropic’s New Consulting Venture Makes Its First Acquisition
title_zh: Anthropic 的新咨询公司进行首次收购
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The new artificial intelligence enterprise services firm backed by Blackstone Inc., Anthropic PBC and Hellman & Friedman has picked a San Francisco firm called Fractional AI as the operational centerpiece of the as-yet unnamed venture.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——由 Blackstone Inc.、Anthropic PBC 和 Hellman & Friedman 支持的新人工智能企业服务公司选择了旧金山一家名为 Fractional AI 的公司作为这家尚未命名的企业的运营核心。

title: New Mexico regulators scrutinize Blackstone-TXNM stock trade in merger review
title_zh: 新墨西哥州监管机构在合并审查中审查 Blackstone-TXNM 股票交易
summary: Consumer and renewable energy advocates say the stock transaction gave Blackstone an early stake in TXNM Energy before regulators could negotiate acquisition-related conditions or customer protections. The companies deny wrongdoing.
summary_zh: 消费者和可再生能源倡导者表示，此次股票交易使 Blackstone 在监管机构就收购相关条件或客户保护进行谈判之前获得了 TXNM Energy 的早期股份。这些公司否认有不当行为。

title: A Look At Diversified Energy’s Valuation As Oklahoma Asset Deal With Carlyle Expands Its Portfolio
title_zh: 随着俄克拉荷马州资产交易与凯雷扩大其投资组合，多元化能源的估值一览
summary: Diversified Energy (DEC) has drawn fresh attention after reaching an agreement with Carlyle to acquire additional oil and gas assets in Oklahoma using asset backed financing, while reporting higher first quarter production and reaffirming 2026 output guidance.
summary_zh: 多元化能源公司 (DEC) 与凯雷达成协议，利用资产支持融资收购俄克拉荷马州的更多石油和天然气资产，同时公布第一季度产量增加并重申 2026 年产量指引，引发了新的关注。
